source_summary: Chinese snowy landscape with steep pale mountains, temple architecture among pines, cliff pavilions, winter trees, a bridge, riverside village, and a small boat; inscriptions, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_snow_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the tall snow-covered peak and descending left mountain mass, including the pale cliff face, ridge crest, ravines, and scattered dark vegetation patches, but excluding all nearby calligraphy and seals.
must_preserve: thin gray contour lines along the peak and cliff edges
soft blue-gray wash on the shaded rock faces
unpainted snow reserves and pale mist-like blank areas
vertical crack linework and dry-brush ravines
small black stippled shrub clusters on ledges and lower slopes

motifs.name: upper_monastery_roofs
motifs.description: Isolate the upper mountain monastery skyline: pagoda, layered tiled roofs, pale halls, and rows of windswept pines across the upper right ridge, avoiding adjacent red seals.
must_preserve: stacked pagoda tiers with reddish-brown accents
fine dark roof-tile strokes and upturned roof edges
horizontal bands of pine needles above and behind roofs
faint gray wall washes and architectural outlines
delicate mist-softened building silhouettes in the background

motifs.name: red_cloister_pine_wall
motifs.description: Isolate the lower monastery terrace with reddish walls, roofed corridors, vertical supports, and a screen of slender pines descending the snowy slope.
must_preserve: muted red-orange wall washes
thin roof geometry and corridor lines
dark vertical posts and trunks
dense short pine-needle strokes along rooflines
snowy slope edge and pale gray retaining-wall texture

motifs.name: right_cliff_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the cliffside pavilion with peaked roof, surrounding tall pines, and the snowy rock platform beneath it on the middle-right side.
must_preserve: triangular pavilion roof with fine ink outline
dark clustered pine needles around the roof and terrace
slender pine trunks descending beside the cliff
angular rock ledge contours and pale snow reserves
black stippled moss dots on cliff edges

motifs.name: central_gorge_pine_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the central snowy ravine with layered rock shelves and the compact grove of straight, needle-like pines rising from the valley floor.
must_preserve: vertical pine trunks with comb-like needle marks
soft gray washes defining stepped rock ledges
dark dotted moss clusters along ledge breaks
snow-white gaps between trees and rocks
fine dry-brush cracks in the ravine walls

motifs.name: arched_stone_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the low arched stone bridge crossing the stream near the lower left-center, with the adjoining snowy banks and light stream contours only.
must_preserve: single rounded arch opening
thin ink lines describing the bridge parapet and stone surface
pale gray wash under the arch
snowy bank contours at both ends
subtle water-edge lines around the stream crossing

motifs.name: winter_village_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right riverside village with cottages nestled among tall leafless winter trees and a small background stand of evergreens.
must_preserve: branching bare-tree linework with many fine twigs
dark textured trunks and root bases
small hut roofs and wall outlines tucked between trees
muted warm color accents on village walls
compact evergreen strokes behind the houses
snowy ground contours and bank edges

motifs.name: small_river_boat
motifs.description: Isolate the tiny narrow boat on the lower river with its small figures and minimal water indication, without including the surrounding village or bridge.
must_preserve: slender curved hull drawn with fine ink
tiny seated or standing figure marks
small pole or oar strokes
light gray shadow/water strokes beneath the boat
delicate scale relative to the open snowy river

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
